text:
The shape with three sides is a triangle.

Here is a funny anecdote based on the text:

Chris walked into the gym with the swagger of a man who had just watched one YouTube tutorial on "How to Lift Heavy Things." He approached the new weight machine, which looked less like exercise equipment and more like a robot waiting to be born. With a confident smirk, he sat down, adjusted the pads, and struck a pose that screamed, "I am the apex predator of cardio."

But then, the machine decided it had other plans. Instead of lifting weights, it lifted Chris’s dignity. He found himself locked in an awkward, mechanical hug, his limbs pinned by padded levers that seemed to have a personal vendetta against human flexibility. He waved his arms frantically, searching for a release button that was clearly labeled in tiny, alien hieroglyphs.

Meanwhile, a group of regulars nearby stopped their squats to watch the spectacle. One guy actually started clapping. Chris, trapped and turning a shade of red that matched the gym’s branding, shouted, "It’s part of the workout! It’s called... core stability!" But as the machine slowly rotated him toward the mirror, he realized the only thing he was stabilizing was his own embarrassment. The gym-goers weren't just chuckling; they were taking notes for their next group chat meme.
